notes.title: Regarding the release date
notes.notes:
I'm Kajinoyu.

We have decided to postpone the release of “Me and (My) Cat's Island” from December 2024 to sometime in 2025. I’m sorry.

I’ll do my best to have it ready for release as early as possible next year!

notes.title: Demo Now Available
notes.notes:
I'm Kajinoyu.

The demo for "Me and (My) Cat's Island" is now available! You can play up to stage 3, and it runs smoothly on SteamDeck, so please give it a try.

Feel free to share videos and screenshots without any restrictions. We’d love to see your posts with the hashtag #meandmycatsisland .

notes.title: 【Event Exhibition Information】Tokyo Game Dungeon 4
notes.notes:
I'm Kajinoyu.

We will be exhibiting "Me and (My) Cat’s Island" at Tokyo Game Dungeon 4, which will take place over two days on January 20th (Saturday) and January 21st (Sunday), 2024.

Our exhibition will be on the second day, January 21st (Sunday), at Booth F-2b.

The exhibition will feature a hands-on display of the trial version using SteamDeck, and we will be distributing flyers. Until the completion of the game, we are refraining from participating in events, so we will showcase it as the "final trial version."

If you plan to attend the event, please feel free to try it out. We would appreciate the opportunity to observe your gameplay, as it will serve as a reference for adjustments leading up to the release.
